sources.title: LookThere! Sparse Vision by Reinforced Selection - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: 3 LookThere: Sparse Vision We model perception as two inter-dependent processes between a token selector that learns where to look and a feature extractor that learns what to represent (Fig. 4). We train both jointly to recover task-relevant information from sparse input.

sources.snippet: LookThere is an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that achieves extreme computational efficiency in vision transformers by dynamically selecting task-relevant tokens.
